author: Inside Edition
description: A DWI suspect allegedly ran from police, straight into dangerous waters. The St. Charles Parish Sheriff in Louisiana says Victor Rivas was stopped by law enforcement after people reported a car driving recklessly. Rivas was pulled over and allegedly fled the scene on foot, then tried to swim away, but the police got some unexpected assistance in the form of an alligator. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Alligator Helps Deputies Apprehend Fleeing Suspect

title: What Were The 'Roofie Murders?' #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: This swimmer is lucky someone spotted her when they did. A Volusia County Sheriff's deputy happened to notice something floating in the water close to shore. When he realized it was a person, lying face-down, he immediately ran in to save her. Another beach visitor helped him drag the woman back to the beach. Once on land, CPR was performed to revive her. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Woman Pulled From Ocean And Revived After Nearly Drowning
